services.title: Veneers
services.text: Veneers are thin, durable, tooth-colored porcelain shells that are attached to the front of teeth.
services.lead: Veneers are thin, durable, tooth-colored porcelain shells that are attached to the front of teeth. This cosmetic feature can treat small gaps between teeth, severe staining, misshapen or uneven teeth, and much more. Veneers can completely transform your smile and last for years. Once veneers are placed on the tooth, they cannot be detached.

about.title: About FLO dentistry
text: Here at FLO Dentistry, it’s our mission to provide the ultimate dental experience by way of trusting relationships, exceptional care, and healthy smiles. Rice Military is our home, and patient satisfaction is at the core of our practice. We welcome every patient who walks through our doors as a part of our family. That’s why we will only recommend the same treatment that we would give to our own loved ones. And with our beautiful space located on the first floor of the Vic at Interpose, you’ll enjoy free enclosed parking just outside of our office.

Born overseas in Amman, Jordan, Dr. Amin came to the U.S. when he was six years old. His family planted roots in Houston, Texas – the place he’s called his home ever since. By the time Dr. Amin reached high school and became a star athlete on his football team, he was diagnosed with leukemia. Doctors had questions if he could ever play again but after rigorous chemo, Dr. Amin emerged in even better shape than he was before, and went on to play football and study Biology at the University of Houston.

Our crew is made up of kind, purpose-driven people who put patients first. Houstonites at heart, we’re constantly inspired by our city’s levity and southern hospitality. We bring our best dentist approach every day, providing you with a memorable experience, knowledgeable service, and second-to-none comfort. Our standards are high, and we wouldn’t want to have it any other way.
